input.overview: Shoot 'n Scoot uses the horizontal position of each physical shot to move an on-screen character between lanes. Choose City, Jungle, or Dungeon, collect coins and power-ups, and move away from obstacles. Extra lives forgive a collision, while the launch or yellow cabinet button can spend coins to pause the scrolling briefly.
input.simpleOverview: Choose an environment, then shoot toward the lane where you want the character to move. Collect coins and power-ups, avoid obstacles, and spend coins on a brief pause only when the screen becomes unsafe.
input.summary: Select City, Jungle, or Dungeon, then use the horizontal position of each shot to move into collectibles and away from obstacles. Extra lives absorb crashes; the launch or yellow button can spend coins for a short pause.

quickInfo.name: Lane control
quickInfo.summary: The left-to-right position of a physical shot moves the character to the corresponding on-screen lane.

quickInfo.name: Collectibles
quickInfo.summary: Move through coins, power-ups, and extra lives while staying out of the path of obstacles.

quickInfo.name: Pause
quickInfo.summary: Press launch or the yellow cabinet button to spend coins and stop the scrolling briefly.

quickInfo.name: Environments
quickInfo.summary: Choose City, Jungle, or Dungeon before launch; each is a separate scrolling course.

steps.text: Use the flippers to choose City, Jungle, or Dungeon, then launch the ball.
Read the character's lane on the lower display and shoot through the matching left, center, or right area to move.
Move into coins and power-ups, but give upcoming obstacles priority over a risky collectible.
If a collision spends an extra life, re-establish a safe lane before chasing the next item.
When no safe move is available, press launch or the yellow cabinet button to spend coins on a brief scrolling pause.
Keep enough coins available for an emergency pause.
Collect extra lives when the route is safe so one later collision does not end the run.
Continue matching physical shot position to the safest on-screen lane until the level is complete.

playfieldReferences.label: Horizontal control lanes
playfieldReferences.description: The physical left-to-right shot areas that move the on-screen character into the corresponding lane.

playfieldReferences.label: Coin-spending pause control
playfieldReferences.description: The cabinet control that briefly pauses scrolling by spending collected coins.

cautions.issue: Shoot 'n Scoot works with every P3 upper module.
cautions.response: Aim by the lower display's horizontal lane rather than memorizing a module-specific target or full shot.
The launch or yellow button spends collected coins, so keep it as an emergency recovery tool.
